name: new30__facebook_comments
description: Only Features_Variant_1.csv (40949 rows); no merging of overlapping variants. Predict future comments using page descriptors and observed post history. Exclude 25 page-level comment aggregate columns because computation cutoff cannot be independently verified. Outer group split uses the first four page-descriptor values as a conservative surrogate identity, not a verified page ID. Original comments scale, RMSE; no target-dependent log transform. Use the frozen split; never access test labels or refit on validation.
